Data freshness & limits

  • Congress trades: Quiver Quant's recent list (latest ~300 disclosures only). Disclosures lag trades by up to 45 days; amounts are ranges.
  • Whales: SEC 13F filings, latest vs prior quarter. 13Fs are filed up to 45 days after quarter end, long US positions only; options excluded.
  • Watched: Pelosi via Quiver (House PTRs). Trump via OCR of scanned OGE 278-T PDFs — names, dates, and amounts may contain OCR errors; always verify with the linked PDF.
  • Tickers for 13F issuers are matched by name and may be blank. Not investment advice.
